2M.1 We are to give glory and praise unto God.

points: David asks the Most High to bow down His ear and hear him, for he is poor and needy, and to preserve his soul, for he is holy; to save His servant that trusteth in Him and be merciful, for he cries daily.

note.label: Psalm 86: Bow Down Thine Ear, O Lord

points: He asks the Most High to rejoice the soul of His servant, for unto Him David lifts up his soul; for the Lord is good and ready to forgive, and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon Him.

note.label: Psalm 86: Bow Down Thine Ear, O Lord

points: David asks the Most High to give ear to his prayer and attend to the voice of his supplications; in the day of his trouble he will call upon Him, for He will answer him.

note.label: Psalm 86: Bow Down Thine Ear, O Lord

points: Among the gods there is none like unto Him, neither are there any works like His works; all nations whom He has made shall come and worship before Him and glorify His name, for He is great and doeth wondrous things, He is God alone.

note.label: Psalm 86: Bow Down Thine Ear, O Lord

points: David asks the Most High to teach him His way, that he may walk in His truth, and to unite his heart to fear His name; he will praise Him with all his heart and glorify His name forevermore.

note.label: Psalm 86: Bow Down Thine Ear, O Lord

points: Great is His mercy toward David, and He has delivered his soul from the lowest hell.

note.label: Psalm 86: Bow Down Thine Ear, O Lord

points: The proud are risen against David and the assemblies of violent men have sought after his soul and have not set the Most High before them; but He is a God full of compassion and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

note.label: Psalm 86: Bow Down Thine Ear, O Lord

points: David asks the Most High to turn unto him and have mercy, to give His strength unto His servant and save the son of His handmaid, and to show him a token for good, that they which hate Him may see it and be ashamed, because the Lord has holpen and comforted him.
